summary: The entry CrowdStrike Falcon package: an AI-based next-generation antivirus in one lightweight, cloud-managed agent, plus device control.
value: Malware, ransomware and fileless attacks are stopped on computers and servers before they run.
The agent installs in minutes and needs no daily signature updates.
Unknown USB sticks and devices cannot connect without permission.
simple: AI-powered next-generation antivirus in one lightweight agent managed from the cloud: installs in minutes without a reboot and needs no daily signature updates. Stops malware, ransomware and more sophisticated attacks, including fileless ones, on Windows, macOS and Linux computers and servers — online and offline. Controls the use of USB drives, SD cards and Thunderbolt devices. Also protects Android and iOS smartphones: spots malicious activity and keeps unauthorized users away from corporate data. Help with installation and setup — Express Support. The host firewall, detection and response (EDR), threat hunting, identity protection, IT hygiene and SIEM are not part of this bundle.
notIncluded: No EDR (event recording and investigation): that is in Falcon Enterprise.
Host firewall management comes with Falcon Pro.
classification: Falcon Prevent (NGAV) is EPP; Device Control maps to the device control class; Mobile Device Protection and Express Support stay in the text.
Identity Protection, IT Hygiene and Next-Gen SIEM are “✗” in every package and are not counted as classes.
